tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light; violet-tinted near-black in dark (never pure black).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: facts strip, entry card body, theme-toggle fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, nav, labels and primary text on bg, surface or lavender.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph and lead text on bg, surface or lavender.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text (dates, labels, captions, reply-time note). Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and lavender in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and footer rules, card outlines, toggle outline. Decorative, not for controls.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Divider above each fact in the About sidebar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary buttons, text links, active-nav underline, the short rule over Let's Connect. Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and lavender in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Brand tint: Let's Connect section, entry pull-quote panel, work-image placeholders. A ground for ink, body and accent.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Placeholder and small text set directly on lavender when it should read as brand-colored.

tokens.name: doodle
tokens.usage: Tooth doodle strokes only. Decorative, deliberately low contrast; never for text or meaning.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Form input and textarea fill.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Form input outline. Meets 3:1 against field and lavender in both themes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-value gap in fact pairs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Form label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups; image to caption.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Divider to content in the About sidebar.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gaps in the facts strip and footer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Nav item gap; work-card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section heading to its content.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (max-width 1280px container).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Column gap in two-column sections.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Images, work placeholders, entry cards: the brand's edges are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Portrait circle and the theme toggle.
